_notes: V8.5 (config_version 9; GitHub serves v8): App Open lifecycle fix. app_open.minimum_background_seconds 1 -> 30 and the new app_open.min_completed_sessions 3 (no App Open in a player's first three launches, per Google's recommendation). Everything else as v8.

HOME MUSIC: full songs from their beginning, looping until another song is chosen; a new song is prepared while the current one keeps playing, then a real-time equal-power crossfade (crossfade_duration_seconds, 0.3-4); tapping the playing song changes nothing; the free starter song plays on a first launch, then the last chosen song; after gameplay, the song just played. Adjustable: enabled, autoplay_on_home, remember_selected_song, play_last_gameplay_song_on_return, crossfade_duration_seconds, volume_multiplier (0.1-1 of the player's music volume; volume 0 stays silent), play_icon_size_ratio (0.12-0.22), show_equalizer, show_now_playing, highlight_active_card. The other keys below describe behaviour fixed in code; a different value is refused with a note. Choosing music never counts a PLAY, never shows an ad, never unlocks a song.

INTERSTITIAL PLACEMENTS: interstitial.placements switches each placement; all of them share ONE cooldown (minimum_interval_seconds), the initial delay, the gap after a rewarded ad, the gap after an App Open (app_open_gap_seconds, >= 30 s) and the gap after any full-screen ad. Any interstitial shown resets the PLAY counter. Never during a song or countdown; never right after a rewarded revive; never on PAUSE or RESUME; never when exiting the app.

CHARACTER SHOP: fish_purchase_enabled and rewarded_unlock_enabled switch the two unlock ways (one confirmed rewarded ad = the selected character owned for good). price_overrides {character_id: price} must stay inside the character's rarity range (Classic 50-150, Rare 200-400, Epic 500-900, Legendary 1000-1500, Mythic 1800-2500); the starter (lilac) is always free. A file can never remove or grant ownership, and a price change never affects characters already owned.

STARTUP (runtime; read from the local/cached file at launch, a newly fetched one applies from the next launch): prefer_ads_ready_before_home (wait for the first rewarded load to finish, ready or not), ads_prepare_timeout_seconds (2-15; the whole splash also has a fixed 20 s cap in code), initialize_admob_early (returning players whose earlier consent allows ads start the SDK alongside the consent refresh), app_open_during_splash (the cold-start App Open may show while loading, never over an interactive HOME), preload_banner (loaded hidden during the splash). Code always lets HOME open on timeout and offline; a file can't change that.
SPLASH: animation_enabled, show_loading_status, reduced_effects (fewer particles, no sparkles or corner equalizers). The bar always shows real progress.
OMITTED = UNCHANGED: a setting missing from this file keeps the game's current value; leaving one out never switches another format on.

RUNTIME (applied from this file, no rebuild): ads_enabled, test_mode, max_ad_content_rating, refresh_minutes, safe_mode.*, mediation.*, rewarded.*, providers.admob rewarded_id / rewarded_fallback_ids / interstitial_id / banner_id / app_open_id, providers.levelplay rewarded/interstitial ad unit ids, song_unlock.*, interstitial.*, app_open.*, banner.*, continue_game.*, countdown.*, ad_break.*, ad_stretch.*.
INITIALIZATION-TIME (read once per app start): providers.levelplay.app_key, mediation.secondary (LevelPlay is started at launch only when it is enabled).
BUILD-TIME: providers.admob.app_id (packaged in the Android manifest). Shown for reference; changing it here has no effect.
AdMob unit IDs are accepted only from the same AdMob account as the app ID built into the APK; production units are used only by a build with production_ready = true. Test mode stays on.
DASHBOARD ONLY: every 'admob_dashboard' block (Liftoff, Meta, Mintegral) and 'levelplay_dashboard' block (Unity Ads; ironSource Ads uses the LevelPlay app key). References only.
NEVER put secrets in this public file (reporting API keys, secret keys, refresh tokens, skeys). The game warns if it finds one.

PLATFORM ORDER: mediation.primary is always AdMob. mediation.secondary 'levelplay' is asked only when AdMob has no ad ready, at most one ad per request, and only for operational failures (no fill, timeout); it stays 'none' until LevelPlay has passed a real Android device test. mediation.regional (off) can limit the secondary to listed countries, from the device's region setting, never its location.
SAFE MODE: safe_mode.enabled blocks every new ad request; disable_* blocks one format. Earned rewards are never taken back.

AD BREAK vs INTERSTITIAL: 'ad_break' here is the optional REWARDED offer (+Neon Fish) on Results, off by default; the interstitial 'AD BREAK' card is part of interstitial.*. Rewards: fish only in this build.

AD STRETCH (off): reduction only; it can lengthen the interstitial interval and raise the PLAY count within its range, never below interstitial.minimum_interval_seconds / play_interval. Session signals only, no age or profiling.
NO ADS: entitlements come only from a verified purchase; this build has none and the file can't grant one.
Raise config_version on every edit: the game ignores a file older than the one it already has.

SAFETY LIMITS IN CODE (a file can't lift them): countdown 3-5 s; revive 0-10; interstitial play_interval 1-20, minimum interval >= 30 s, initial delay >= 30 s, rewarded gap >= 15 s, max wait 3-10 s, retry >= 5 s; min gap after any full-screen ad 30-600 s; app open cooldown >= 60 s; banners never on gameplay, continue, transition or results; first song always free.
